items.title: 9.9.2 Titration curve and equivalence point (titration curve aur equivalence point) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.9.2, printed pages 206-208, with Table 9.7 and Quick Check 9.6 as self-checks.

blocks.text: pH curve (titration curve) woh graph hai jo dale gaye titrant ke volume (hajm) ke muqable solution ka pH dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “verses” chhapa hai; sahi lafz “versus” (muqable mein) hai.

blocks.title: Equivalence point
blocks.text: Equivalence point woh point hai jahan dala gaya titrant analyte solution ko bilkul poora neutralize karne ke liye kaafi ho.

Titration curves dikhate hain ke acidic ya basic solution mein basic ya acidic solution dalne se pH kaise badalta hai. Titration curve se hum aisa indicator chunte hain jo bata de ke titration complete ho gaya aur equivalence point aa gaya. Titration ka end point woh hai jahan indicator colour (rang) badalta hai. Hum aisa indicator chunte hain jis ka end point equivalence point ke qareeb ho.
Example ke taur par HCl ki NaOH se titration lein. Shuru mein solution mein sirf strong acid hai. Strong acid poora dissociate hota hai, is liye H⁺ ki concentration zyada aur pH bohat kam hota hai.
NaOH dalne par us ke OH⁻ ions HCl ke H⁺ ions ko neutralize karna shuru karte hain aur pH barhta hai.

Equivalence point tab aata hai jab dale gaye OH⁻ ki amount acid mein asal H⁺ ki amount ke barabar (stoichiometric taur par) ho jaye. Strong acid-strong base titration mein equivalence point par pH 7.0 hota hai. Is jagah curve mein pH tezi se oopar uchhalta hai, acidic se neutral. End point ke aas paas pH taqreeban 4.0 se 10.0 tak badalta hai. Equivalence par pH 7.0 hai, is liye phenolphthalein jaisa indicator istemal ho sakta hai kyunke woh is range mein colour badalta hai.

blocks.alt: Titration curve: pH (0 se 14) ke muqable shamil kiye gaye strong base ka volume (0 se 80 mL), points ke saath. pH taqreeban 1 se shuru ho kar dheere barhta hai, 40 mL par taqreeban seedha oopar chhalang lagata hai aur 12.5 ke qareeb thehar jata hai. Dashed line 'pH = 7.00 at equivalence point'. Tez hisse par colour bands phenolphthalein (taqreeban pH 8.2 se 10) aur methyl red (taqreeban pH 4.4 se 6.2), flasks ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.3: Strong acid-strong base titration curve (kitab ki Figure 9.3 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shuru mein pH taqreeban 1 hai kyunke sirf strong acid hai. 40 mL par sara acid neutralize ho jata hai aur pH 4 se 10 tak achanak uchhalta hai; equivalence point par pH 7.00. Phenolphthalein (8.2 se 10) aur methyl red (4.4 se 6.2) dono ki range isi seedhe hisse mein hai, is liye dono kaam kar sakte hain.

Aqueous NH₃ ki HCl se titration lein. Shuru mein solution mein sirf weak base hai jo thora dissociate hota hai, is liye OH⁻ strong base se kam hota hai. Shuru ka pH 7 se zyada magar strong base ke pH se kam hota hai. HCl dalne se OH⁻ kam hota jata hai aur pH girta hai.

Equivalence point se pehle solution buffer jaise hisse (buffer region) mein hota hai jahan pH dheere badalta hai. Weak base aur us ka conjugate acid (bane hue salt se) mil kar buffer ka kaam karte hain, aur acid dalne par pH ki tabdeeli ko moderate (narm) karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai “as the base is added”; is titration mein HCl (acid) dala ja raha hai, is liye sahi “as the acid is added” hai.

blocks.alt: Titration curve: pH (0 se 14) ke muqable shamil kiye gaye HCl(aq) ka volume (0 se 80 mL). pH taqreeban 11 se shuru ho kar 'buffer region' mein dheere girta hai (curve ke saath pink band, jo phenolphthalein ki range bhi hai), 40 mL par tezi se girta hai aur 1.5 ke qareeb thehar jata hai. Dashed lines taqreeban pH 9.2 aur 'pH = 5.27 at equivalence point' par. Methyl red ki band tez fall ko kaatti hai, flask ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.4: Strong acid-weak base titration curve (kitab ki Figure 9.4 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shuru mein pH taqreeban 11 hai (weak base). Buffer region mein pH dheere girta hai, is liye phenolphthalein ki range (pink band) yahan dheere dheere guzar jati hai aur suitable nahi. Equivalence point par pH 5.27 hai (NH₄⁺ halka acidic), aur methyl red ki band tez fall wale hisse par hai, is liye yahan woh behtar hai.
Equivalence point par pH 7 se kam (pH = 5.27) hota hai, kyunke conjugate acid NH₄⁺ thora dissociate ho kar H⁺ chhorta hai aur solution acidic ho jata hai (NH₄⁺ → NH₃ + H⁺).

Equivalence point ke baad pH tezi se girta hai, kyunke ab zyada dala gaya strong acid poora dissociate ho kar bohat H⁺ deta hai. Methyl orange isi range mein colour badalta hai, is liye strong acid-weak base titration ke liye suitable indicator hai.

blocks.prompt: a) End point aur equivalence point mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein hai. Indicator aisa chunte hain ke end point equivalence point ke jitna ho sake qareeb ho.

rows: Jahan dala gaya titrant analyte ko bilkul poora neutralize kar deta hai
Aankh se dekha jata hai (practical point)
Calculation (stoichiometry) se tay hota hai (theoretical point)
Indicator ke chunao par depend karta hai
Sirf reaction ki equation aur amounts par depend karta hai
Achhe indicator ke saath equivalence point ke bohat qareeb hota hai
Strong acid-strong base mein pH 7.0; strong acid-weak base mein pH 5.27

blocks.prompt: b) Indicator acidic aur basic solution mein colour kaise badalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Indicator weak acid HIn hai: HIn ⇌ H⁺ + In⁻, aur HIn aur In⁻ ke colour alag hain. Acid mein H⁺ zyada hai, equilibrium baen taraf chalta hai aur HIn ka colour dikhta hai. Base mein OH⁻ H⁺ ko pani bana kar hata deta hai, HIn aur ionize hota hai, In⁻ zyada ho jata hai aur base wala colour dikhta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Weak acid aur strong base ki titration ke liye suitable indicator batayein.
blocks.explanation: Equivalence point par salt ka anion hydrolyse ho kar OH⁻ deta hai, is liye pH 7 se zyada (basic) hota hai. Is liye phenolphthalein (8.2 se 10.0) suitable hai (Table 9.7).

blocks.prompt: d) Weak acid aur weak base ki titration ke liye suitable indicator batayein.
blocks.explanation: Is titration mein equivalence point ke aas paas pH dheere badalta hai, tez uchhal nahi hota, is liye koi aam indicator tez colour ki tabdeeli nahi deta. Aisi titrations aam taur par indicator ke saath nahi ki jatin.

items: Titration curve: titrant ke volume ke muqable pH. Equivalence point = bilkul neutralization; end point = indicator ka colour badalna, jo equivalence point ke qareeb chuna jata hai.
HCl–NaOH: kam pH se shuru, pH 7 par equivalence, 4 se 10 tak tez uchhal; phenolphthalein.
NH₃–HCl: 7 se oopar shuru, buffer region, pH 5.27 par equivalence (NH₄⁺ acidic); methyl orange.
